summary.en: A transparent always-on-top Live2D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: it blinks, follows the cursor, talks, shows your DeepSeek balance and system stats, and takes over conversation prompts, risk approvals and task progress. A card mode without the illustration is also available.
summary.zh: 昔涟桌面桌宠：透明置顶的 Live2D 立绘，会眨眼、跟着鼠标看、会说话，顺手显示余额与系统状态，还把对话提问、风险审批、任务进度接到桌面上；也可以切成不加载立绘的卡片模式。
